mcqs.question: What did the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) delegation recommend during its visit to the Tirupati Urban Development Authority (TUDA) on 28 May 2025?
options: Complete digitisation of TUDA’s financial and accounting systems
Complete digitisation of TUDA’s land acquisition process only
Review TUDA’s zoning and parks without digitising its accounts
Convert TUDA into a statutory body under the Andhra Pradesh Urban Development Authorities Act
mcqs.explanation: The CAG delegation recommended completing the digitisation of TUDA’s financial and accounting systems. Its visit also reviewed land acquisition, layout planning, zoning and parks, but those were areas of review rather than the specific digitisation recommendation.
